title: Rhythm and Pattern Making
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Creative Arts; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Count beats aloud; block printing with a teacher. Notes are described in words on the phone.

skills.key_step: The child gives note and rest values (semibreve 4, dotted minim 3, minim 2, crotchet 1, quaver half) and groups them in three-beat bars.

floor.question: How many beats does a minim last?

steps: Fill each bar with three beats.
Draw the bar line after beat three.

board.do: A minim and what fills the bar?

misconceptions.ask: How many beats does a crotchet last?
misconceptions.repair: Clap crotchets, minims and quavers while counting.

misconceptions.ask: What do you do at a rest?
misconceptions.repair: Clap a pattern with a rest and stay silent on it.

misconceptions.ask: What does a three-beat bar add up to?
misconceptions.repair: Write a bar of one minim and one crotchet and count it.

misconceptions.ask: How many beats does a dotted minim last?
misconceptions.repair: Clap a minim (2) then add half (1).

checks.question: How many beats in each bar of three-beat time?
A minim plus how many crotchets fill a three-beat bar?

skills.key_step: The child orders block printing (draw a motif, cut the block, ink it, press, repeat in rows) and says a full repeat fills the area evenly.

board.do: Write the steps out of order.

listen_for: Press the block on the paper
misconceptions.ask: What comes first in block printing?
misconceptions.repair: Write each step on a card and put the cards in order.
Press a clean block and an inked block on paper and compare.

misconceptions.ask: What is a full repeat pattern?
misconceptions.repair: Print one motif in a row and then in many rows.

misconceptions.ask: You cut the letter K on a block. How will it print?
misconceptions.repair: Print a block with a cut letter and look.

checks.question: What is a full repeat pattern?
checks.answer: the motif printed again and again in rows to fill the space

checks.question: Which part of the block prints?
